context: A grandmother and grandchild chat about an old story
purpose: Teach: 昨夜/皮膚/棒/手前/即/文法/留学生/毒

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、昨夜お母さんが話してくれた昔話、もう一回聞かせて。
lines.en: Grandma, that old story Mom told me last night, tell it to me one more time.
lines.style: Eager child voice with slightly whiny pleading tone

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ああ、留学生の若者が森で不思議な棒を拾った話かい?
lines.en: Ah, the one about the foreign student who picked up a mysterious stick in the forest?
lines.style: Warm gentle grandmother voice with slow nostalgic pace

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そう!触ったところから皮膚がピリピリしたって所が怖かった。
lines.en: Yes! The part where his skin tingled from where he touched it was scary.
lines.style: Excited child, slightly breathless and animated tone

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あれはね、棒の手前の地面に古い毒が染み込んでいたからなんだよ。
lines.en: That was because old poison had soaked into the ground just in front of the stick, you see.
lines.style: Soft storytelling tone, mysterious and grandmotherly cadence

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 若者は日本語がまだ下手だったのに、即お祈りの言葉を唱えたんでしょ?
lines.en: Even though his Japanese was still poor, he immediately chanted words of prayer, right?
lines.style: Curious inquisitive child mixing awe with wonder

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうそう、文法はめちゃくちゃでも、心が綺麗だったから通じたんだねえ。
lines.en: That's right, even with messy grammar, because his heart was pure, it got through.
lines.style: Tender reflective grandmother, warm and instructive voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも大きくなったら、その若者みたいに勇気を出せるかなあ。
lines.en: When I grow up, I wonder if I can be brave like that young man.
lines.style: Bright dreamy child voice, proud and earnest tone

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: きっと出せるよ。さあ、もう遅いから今夜は早くお休み。
lines.en: I'm sure you can. Now, it's late, so get to sleep early tonight.
lines.style: Affectionate grandmother with soft tucking-in voice
